declaredBreaks.reason: The deprecated organization warehouse credential REST endpoints and CLI organization-credentials option are removed. Callers of those endpoints receive 404 and older CLI commands using that option must configure warehouse credentials on the project instead. Existing project credentials, personal sign-ins and service accounts retain their current behavior. Legacy storage and shared compatibility types remain unchanged.
